name: Ohio
licensingAuthorityNote: The Ohio Construction Industry Licensing Board (OCILB) issues state licenses to Electrical, HVAC, Refrigeration, Plumbing, and Hydronics contractors who perform commercial work.

faqs.question: Which trades does Ohio license at the state level?
faqs.answer: OCILB's out-of-state testing application states that the board "issues state licenses to Electrical, HVAC, Refrigeration, Plumbing, and Hydronics Contractors who perform commercial work."
